THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964 Notice Under Section 7

My No.: E/02/34/8/07(LL/A/7551). Land Ministry’s No.: 03J/84/E/112. This is to inform that the inquiry under Subsection (1) of Section 7 of the land acquisition Act as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 Acoording to the Gazette Number 487/5 dated 05th of January 1988 which was supposed to be held on 08th of March 1988 at 9.30 a.m. in Kalawana Assistant Government agent Office as there were not appeared the inquiry was not forwarded there for here by give notice under Sub Section (1) of Section 7 land acquisition (amendment) Act No. 28 0f 1964 that the government intends to acquire the following land which is required for public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired:

I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act as land Acquisition (amended) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the government intends to acquire following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land and servitude to be acquired. The allotment of known as Dickgodellehena and Pamantote Kumbura shown as Lots 612, 613, 615, 617, 618, 620 and 621 Sheet Number 02

7. Lot No. 621 Name of the Land: Dickgodellehena; Extent: 0.1300 Hectare. Claimants: Mr. Bopitiya Arachchige Siriwardhanahami, Bopitiya, Rakwana

Mrs. Bopitiya Arachchige Podimenike, Pothupitiya, Rakwana With public purpose: “Acquisition of land for the Ranbuka Vidyalaya Pamantota Kumbura and Dickgodellehena in all person interested in bellow aforesaid lands on which is servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agent dully authorized with document in writing, meet me at on the 08th day of November, 2017 at 9.30 a. m. Kalawana Divisional Secretariat and are hereby required to notify to me in writing (with 2 duplicates) on or before me the 1st day of November, 2017 and the nature interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of said lands/ servitude, the amounts of compensation and details of the calculation of such amount. Divisional Secretary, Kalawana. Kalawana Divisional Secretary, 18th August, 2017.
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref No.: PAS/LAND/ACQVI/07/FI/249C/56.

Land Ministry Ref No.: 4/3/15/2012/VE/133. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No: 28 of 1964, that the

Government intends to acquire the following lands servitude which is required for purpose:- Description of land or servitude to be acquired: Under mentioned and shown in the surveyor or General’s plan of F.V.P. 23 Supplement No. 45 Sheet No. 59, situated in the village of Urubokka, Heegoda Grama Niladari Division, Pasgoda Divisional Secretary’s Division in Matara District in Southern Province.
THE SCHEDULE
1. Lot No. 1374 Name of the Land: Dambiliya Waththa alias Dambiliyahena; Description: Scrub Jungle; Claimants: Government; Extent: 2.1011 Hectares.

All person interested in the aforesaid land/ lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Pasgoda on the 22nd day of November, 2017 at 10.00 a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 15th day of November, 2017 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for computation for the said land/ servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. K. N. KAUSHALYA KUMARI, Divisional Secretary, Pasgoda. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Pasgoda. 16th August, 2017.
